product_version: Amazon S3 User Guide and Ceph Squid documentation, checked 2026-10-05
version_sensitive_claims: Q1: Amazon S3 strongly consistent PUT/DELETE/GET/LIST for single object keys; conditional If-None-Match/If-Match is evaluated at write or CompleteMultipartUpload.
Q1: versioned bucket DELETE without version ID creates delete marker.
Q3: multipart ETag is not whole-object MD5; checksums and CompleteMultipartUpload semantics follow current S3 documentation.
Q4: Ceph Squid CRUSH placement rules distribute replicas or erasure-code shards across configured failure domains.
staleness_risks: Q2/Q4 are design models; Ceph behavior is an example and not a claim about Amazon S3 internals.
